description: This file defines an Android Fragment named ActiveNotificationsFragment used to display and manage active notifications within an Android application. It includes functionality to add notifications, update notification summaries, and display the current number of active notifications.

classes.name: ActiveNotificationsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that allows users to add active notifications, manage notification summaries, and display the count of active notifications.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the notification count when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views and sets up click listeners for adding notifications.

methods.name: addNotificationAndUpdateSummaries
methods.description: Creates and posts a new notification, then updates notification summaries and count.

methods.name: updateNotificationSummary
methods.description: Creates or removes the notification summary based on active notifications.

methods.name: updateNumberOfNotifications
methods.description: Displays the current number of active notifications.

methods.name: getNewNotificationId
methods.description: Provides a unique ID for new notifications.

methods.name: getNumberOfNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves the current number of active notifications, excluding the summary notification.
